scenario: No exact backing -> reject, per LSER.18.2 / LSER.15.2 (v1). `mean` / `sum` / `count` / `stdev` / `variance` are exact on `all_time` (SeriesBackendWelfordEwma accumulator), `sliding` (SeriesBackendRingBuffer raw-sample ring buffer), and `sample` (SeriesBackendReservoir reservoir). The `tumbling` form is specified as exact over a per-bucket backing (LSER.18.2 / LSER.14.4 — the most-recently-completed bucket) that v1 does not yet ship; routing it to the Welford accumulator would silently return an exponentially-weighted estimate, not the exact bucket statistic. Pin: `mean tumbling` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_EXACT_BACKING; the diagnostic points at the bounded `sliding` / `all_time` forms.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    mean tumbling 10_min
